reviews.reviewText: Mostly MCQs Kinza Bilal ke past papers se aye thay. Subject thora conceptual tha. Ek question graph mein se aya, ek question recurring mein se, aur MCQs bhi zyada tar graph waly chapter (last walay chapters) se thay.

MCqs mostly files me se the 15 to 20 Vu topper ki past papers wali files me se the and 40 to 44 lectures me se ziada the mcqs wo ache se prepared kr k jaiye ga

 Subjective me 2 questions cards wale the jinki probability nikalni thi aur aik graph ko matrix me convert krna tha aur aik algorithm Wala the pre and post conditions wala...
Baaki paper itna mushkil ni tha..bs mam kinza Bilal k jisne lectures Liye hein aur final term preparation wali videos deikhi Hein unke liye ye kaafi easy tha..
